title: pmat query --coverage-gaps without a coverage file ranks build.rs and a .py lambda as the top aprender-serve gaps
evidence: Run on this checkout: 'No coverage data available', then 30 rows of 0.0% cov from build.rs and baselines/pytorch-wine/lambda_function.py. With nightly coverage.json (run 39080471983) the paths are CI paths (/home/noah/eph-build2/_work/...) and the query returns 'No coverage gaps found' until they are rewritten to the checkout.
repro: pmat query --coverage-gaps --exclude-tests --rank-by impact --limit 30 (no --coverage-file); then same with --coverage-file coverage.json unrewritten
